exposure: Time of day of blood collection
time of day for plasma collection
outcome: Total EVP miRNA counts in maternal plasma
Total EVP miRNA counts in human milk
cohort: 54 mother-child dyads in the New Hampshire Birth Cohort Study
finding: Several factors, including time of day of blood collection, infant age at sample collection, parity, pre-pregnancy BMI, and mode of delivery, may influence maternal EVP miRNA composition during pregnancy and postpartum.
mod_finding: Women who delivered their babies via cesarean section had lower total miRNA counts in milk EVPs and 22 specific EVP miRNAs compared to those who delivered vaginally.
